build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/cache storage/framework/views && chmod -R 775 storage && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && php artisan storage:link && php -S 0.0.0.0:$PORT -t public
